comment: zap.c dobuzz() 5029-5035: pay_for_damage() after a ray destroys a shop door. A debug Valkyrie level-teleports to Dlvl 3, arriving inside Chibougamau's general store beside the keeper (seed chosen from a port scan of 7400200-7400320 for a shop arrival), wishes a wand of fire and zaps it northwest into the closed shop door: zap_over_floor() burns it (D_NODOOR, add_damage(), *shopdamage), so dobuzz() calls pay_for_damage("burn away").
